question: For an agent-produced artifact, which invariants can a property-based test assert without asserting the model's opinion (schema validity, idempotence of re-runs, monotonicity of a counter, absence of a credential) - and which desirable properties are fundamentally untestable?

reviewer.obligation: Re-run checkers against known-good and known-broken fixtures; confirm they fire only on the broken one; confirm two named untestable properties are not implemented as silent checkers.

This record still carries claim id, canonical mechanism, source lineage, evidence tier, confidence band, named settling probe, edges, freshness stamp, snapshot sha256, implemented property runs, and named untestable properties.

source_lineage.note: Claessen & Hughes, QuickCheck (ICFP 2000): properties are universally quantified decidable predicates. The Windows source 05-ECOSYSTEM-AND-FRONTIER-RESEARCH.md and command-center/sources/REGISTER.md are not in this worktree; no section numbers from those files are cited.

title: Identify which properties of an agent's output are genuinely property-testable

untestable_properties.name: Semantic truth of the agent's claims (the model's opinion)
untestable_properties.why: A property 'every evidence.claim is factually true' needs an oracle the artifact does not contain. Property-based tests quantify over decidable predicates on inputs (Claessen & Hughes, QuickCheck, ICFP 2000). Asserting claim-truth would be asserting the model's opinion, which this unit forbids. No known-broken fixture can be built from bytes alone without smuggling in that oracle.

untestable_properties.name: That the artifact is what the user intended / is maximally helpful
untestable_properties.why: Intent and preference are not observational fields on the byte string. A 'known-broken' fixture for unhelpfulness is a human judgment, not a mechanical mutant. Re-running the checker cannot fail closed on a wrong-intent artifact without that judgment.

untestable_properties.name: That a credential-shaped token is a live secret rather than a quote
untestable_properties.why: Regex absence is observational. Distinguishing a live key from a quoted AWS-shaped test fixture requires an oracle (vendor, entropy, context) the artifact bytes do not carry. That judgment is not a property-based test.
